## Summary
Stage A of **P0.15g** — the **offline, no-spend** construction that closes the agent-launch chain the P0.15f live run diagnosed, plus the six additional gaps the offline preflight audit (F1–F6) found downstream of it. This is the last block of construction before the first green editorial Review; **Stage B (deploy + paid runs) is operator-gated and NOT part of this PR.**

Stacked on P0.15f (PR #22). Implements `docs/tickets/16_P0.15g__agent-launch-caps-credential-path-green-review.md` (Stage A) + the companion `docs/tickets/16_P0.15g__preflight-audit.md`.

## What changed (the 8 Stage-A items)
1. **Harness ambient caps (D-P0.15f-1, F6)** — `docker/entrypoint.sh` now retains ambient `+setuid,+setgid,+sys_admin,+sys_chroot`. The missing `+setgid` was the exact live `setpriv: setresgid failed` (agent exited 127). `docker/privsep-check.sh` + `privsep.docker.test.ts` extended to PROVE the harness→agent drop (uid 10002, no EPERM), a **no-CAP_SETGID negative control**, and that the dropped agent still cannot read the secrets file.
2. **Credential injector (D-P0.15f-2)** — new `credential-injector.ts`: a harness-uid streaming reverse proxy that stamps `x-rhema-proxy-credential` (`injectProxyCredential`) and forwards to the egress-proxy. `harness-main.ts` starts it and points the agent's `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` at the loopback injector (upstream = the egress-proxy). The agent env still carries **no** credential (`scrubbed-env.ts` unchanged).
3. **Guided-retry idempotency (K3)** — `materializeWork` makes a target writable before rewriting, so a re-run over a `0444` file no longer `EACCES`.
4. **Native `claude` binary (F1)** — `Dockerfile` installs + build-time asserts (executable by uid `agent`) the vendored linux-x64 binary; `pathToClaudeCodeExecutable` plumbed through the engine + a `resolveClaudeCodeExecutable` helper; `vendor/README.md` operator step.
5. **Skill discovery (F2)** — `stageSkills` symlinks `/app/skills` into `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills`; options set the real `skills:"all"`.
6. **`/work` layout (F3)** — `materializeWork` honors `entry.root` via a shared `resolveSeatRoots` (one source of truth with the §12.6 hook's `compileSeatPolicy`); spawn/read cwd = `request.cwd` (`/work/project`). A boundary test proves the hook **ALLOWs** the draft read at the materialized path and **DENIES** the pre-F3 path (`boundary.attested violations = 0`).
7. **Model + ids (F4)** — `options.model` = main-per-tier (explicit, allowlisted, priceable); roster uses **bare** ids (`claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-fable-5`); Haiku 4.5 priced in the rate table (additive — see below); a matrix test asserts every roster + main id is on its tier allowlist AND priceable.
8. **F5 option mapping** — `toSdkOptions` now emits **only real vendored-SDK `Options` fields** and drops the silently-ignored `skillsDir`/`cacheControlTtl`/`maxSubagentDepth`/`maxConcurrentSubagents`/`sessionStore`, recording that those caps are un-enforced by the wrapper (defense = the egress-proxy + the uid split).

## Design decisions
- **`resolveSeatRoots` shared by the harness materializer and the hook** so the on-disk `/work` layout and the §12.6 boundary are drift-free by construction (F3 is a real reconciliation, not the P0.15f `cwd=/work` symptom-patch).
- **Rate table v1 gains `claude-haiku-4-5` ($1/$5)** — a *deliberate* exception to "never edit a version in place": the id was already on `MODELS_BY_TIER` but unpriceable, so a base-tier research request failed closed before metering; `$0` inference to date means no `usage_records` row can change retroactively. The peg-stability purpose of the invariant is preserved.
- **F1 uses `pathToClaudeCodeExecutable` + a build-time Docker assertion** (guarded on the ~216 MB binary's presence). CI/placeholder builds warn; the assertion fires on the operator's real image build — inherent to the vendoring model.
